visual_text: 2022 review of UK studies, 2010 to 2020, all ages
Welfare advice in health settings: what the studies show
Reported by some: better mental health
Physical health: mostly self-reported by some people, studies poor quality
Eight of the 14 studies were case studies and quality was generally poor. An evidence gap on health effects is not evidence of no benefit.
Reece et al., Soc Sci Med, 2022
alt_text: Two-column card on welfare advice in UK health settings, a 2022 review of studies from 2010 to 2020, all ages. Left: reported in all 14 studies, improved financial security. Right, dashed: not yet measured well; better mental health reported by some, physical health mostly self-reported. Quality was poor; a gap is not evidence of no benefit.
